1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 她会一直搬家才能找到质量好的教育：她要一直搬家，才能找到质量好的教育，才能 introduces a necessary condition, so 要 expresses that the action is required; 会 mainly expresses future likelihood or ability.
